bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears improved to 3-1 on Sunday with a 23-12 win over the New York Jets at Soldier Field, with the team's quarterback depth, running game and defense emerging as strengths early this season . Running back Kyle Monangai led the offense to a franchise record in the victory, though he suffered an injury during the performance, while the Bears also placed offensive lineman Braxton Jones on Reserve/Injured after the game.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions fell 32-26 to the Carolina Panthers in a Sunday Night Football matchup, with Panthers receiver Tetairoa McMillan dominating the game by catching 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns. Despite the loss exposing continued defensive struggles, head coach Dan Campbell and his players publicly backed second-year defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard rather than placing blame on him.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers held on to beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 17-14 on Sunday, with the defense securing the win behind Evan Williams' big day helping Packers overcome the loss of Edgerrin Cooper . The victory came despite a shaky offensive performance, as the team struggled to put the game away and dealt with guards Aaron Banks (knee/toe) and Jacob Monk (quadricep) out, with Green Bay taking only 52 players to Tampa .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings improved to 4-0 after defeating the Miami Dolphins in Week 4, with T.J. Hockenson and kicker Will Reichard leading the offense while star receiver Justin Jefferson sat out due to a sprained ankle.
